caption:
Steelers owner Rooney backs McCarthy after Rodgers interview

Aaron Rodgers · Sport

Steelers owner Art Rooney II reacted to Wednesday's interview from Aaron Rodgers, saying 'insubordination can't be tolerated.' He said he was 'disappointed in where this went' with the now-former quarterback. Rooney added that he has '100% confidence in Mike McCarthy.'

Reported by ESPN; CBS Sports; The Guardian. Written by AI.
